text: DSH Brand Studio（DSH 网页客户端插件）：自定义侧边栏顶部的品牌标志和名称，并将设置加入通用设置页。插件注册侧边栏标志与名称槽位，以及五项通用设置。用户可选择账号头像、上传图片或官方标志，调整标志形状，编辑品牌名称，并切换自定义名称后的 Harness 徽标。上传图片会裁切并缩放后保存在本机，设置按设备保存。适合希望个性化 DSH 外观的用户；账号头像选项需登录 DSH 账号，不需要额外 API 密钥。

DSH Brand Studio customizes the sidebar mark and name through five General Settings controls. Choose an account avatar, upload an image, set its shape and a custom name, and toggle the Harness badge. Images are cropped and stored locally. Account avatars need sign-in; no extra API key is required.
我想把 DSH 侧边栏的 Logo 换成自己的图片。
能不能用我的账号头像作为应用左上角标志？
Let me replace the app's sidebar logo and label with my own branding.
DSH Brand Studio 的功能「自定义侧边栏品牌」：在侧边栏标志与名称槽位显示所选图片和自定义名称。通过通用设置选择账号头像或上传图片、输入名称；上传图会裁成方形并缩放后保存在本机。
DSH Brand Studio 的功能「品牌样式设置」：在通用设置中选择圆形或圆角矩形标志，并为自定义名称开启 Harness 徽标。名称留空时恢复官方字标，上传图片的预览和编辑控件也会随图片来源状态变化。

text:
dsh-brand-studio README · 功能：| 能力 | 选项 | 效果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Logo 来源 | 已登录账号头像 / 上传的图片 / 官方标志 | 决定左上角显示哪张图，展开态与收起后的图标条同时生效 |
| Logo 形状 | 纯圆 / 圆角矩形 | 纯圆会额外写 `corner-shape: round`，否则会被主题的超椭圆规则拉成圆角方 |
| 品牌名称 | 自由文本（≤ 24 字） | 留空即使用官方字标 DeepSeek Harness |
| Harness 徽标 | 开 / 关，仅自定义名称可用 | 在自定义名称后追加官方的 Harness 药丸徽标 |

几条行为规则：

dsh-brand-studio README · 功能：- **官方名称时 Harness 固定显示**：官方字标是一整张图（DeepSeek + Harness），不拆开，
  所以名称留空时徽标开关被锁定，官方 logo 不会被改坏。
- **账号头像仅登录后可选**；未登录、账号无头像、未上传图片时都会回落到官方标志，
  而不是留一个空格子。
- **只有「上传的图片」来源才可更换/移除图片**，账号图片属于账号、官方标志属于构建，
  都不允许在本插件里改动。
- 选择「上传的图片」但还没存过图时，会自动弹出文件选择框。

dsh-brand-studio README · 截图：侧边栏效果（账号头像 + 自定义名称 + 官方 Harness 徽标）：

设置项位于「设置 → 通用设置」页，共五行：

dsh-brand-studio README · 环境要求：- DSH **0.2.1-rc.3** 上下（开发与验证版本；槽位 API 若变更需同步调整）。
- Web 版与桌面版（Windows / macOS）均可；Windows 标题栏的 1px 布局偏移已适配。

dsh-brand-studio README · 安装：在 DSH 的插件页里直接装，不需要命令行：

1. 侧边栏打开 **插件**，点右上角 **添加插件**。
2. 在输入框里填仓库地址：

```
   https://github.com/elliotmasheal/dsh-brand-studio
   ```

3. 装好后启用 `dsh-brand-studio`（如果没有自动启用），刷新页面。
4. 打开 设置 → 通用设置，向下滚动看到五行品牌设置即为成功。

仓库如果还是私有的，安装的那台机器需要有访问权限；转公开后直接填地址即可。

卸载：在插件列表里移除该 bundle，品牌槽位会自动交还给官方占位。

dsh-brand-studio README · 使用：设置 → 通用设置 页里新增的 5 行（顺序 40–44，位于「性能与用量」之后）：

| 行 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Logo 来源 | 三选一；未登录时账号头像项置灰 |
| Logo 形状 | 纯圆 / 圆角矩形，作用于左上角标志与截图预览 |
| Logo 图片 | 32px 预览 + 选择 / 移除；非「上传」来源时禁用 |
| 品牌名称 | 输入即生效；「恢复官方」清空 |
| Harness 徽标 | 官方名称时锁定为开 |

配置保存在渲染进程的 `localStorage`（键 `dsh.custom-brand.v1`），上传图片会先居中裁成
192×192 的 WebP 再存，避免占满配额。**仅本机有效，不跨设备同步。**

dsh-brand-studio README · 实现说明：- 只占用官方槽位，不改其它插件的 DOM：
  - `sidebar.brand.mark` / `sidebar.brand.name`：有可显示的替换内容时才占位
    （优先级 `-1` 覆盖官方占位），否则自动让位给官方鱼形标志与字标。
  - `settings.general.item`：5 行设置，作为通用设置页的加法座位，不新增页面。
- 账号头像走官方 Remote 通道：`ctx.remote.account.watch()` 订阅登录状态，
  `getProfile({ version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds })` 读取 `avatarUrl`，
  图片在浏览器里解码成功后才上屏。
- Harness 徽标不是文字，而是按官方字标里的同一套几何（药丸底 + 反白字母）重绘的
  inline SVG，颜色取主题 token，深浅色都一致。
- 界面仅使用主题 token（`--dsw-alias-*`、`--dsw-radius-*`），不引入 Harness 客户端包。

dsh-brand-studio README · 目录结构：```
dshBrandStudio/
├─ client.js           浏览器半（品牌槽位 + 设置行），全部逻辑在这里
├─ index.js            宿主半（空实现，占位）
├─ cordis.patch.yml    bundle 补丁：插入 brand-studio 这一行

dsh-brand-studio README · 开发：```sh
node --check client.js
node --check index.js
```

改完 `client.js` 保存即热重载，无需重启。更多约定见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。

dsh-brand-studio README · 已知限制：- Harness 徽标的几何是从当前版本 DSH 的字标里取的；官方改版后需要同步更新
  `HARNESS_GLYPHS`。
- 设置存在本机 `localStorage`，清理站点数据会丢失（可用「恢复官方」重置）。
- 与其它同样占用 `sidebar.brand.*` 的插件互斥（都由优先级决定谁生效）。
- 不能把设置嵌进「账号与余额」页：设置框架没有页内插槽，同 id 会替换整页。

An **unofficial community plugin** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).
It replaces the brand mark and name at the top of the sidebar with your own, and folds
its settings into the existing **Settings → General** page — no extra entry in the
settings navigation.

text:
dsh-brand-studio README · Features：| Setting | Options | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Logo source | Signed-in account avatar / Uploaded image / Official mark | Which picture the brand row and the collapsed rail show |
| Logo shape | Circle / Rounded square | A circle also sets `corner-shape: round`, otherwise the theme's superellipse turns it into a squircle |
| Brand name | free text (≤ 24 chars) | Empty keeps the official `DeepSeek Harness` wordmark |
| Harness badge | on / off, custom names only | Appends the official "HARNESS" pill badge after a custom name |

dsh-brand-studio README · Features：- The official wordmark is one picture spelling "DeepSeek Harness", so it is never split:
  with the name empty the badge toggle is locked on and the shipped logo is left intact.
- The account-avatar source needs a signed-in account; a signed-out account, an account
  without a picture, or an empty upload slot falls back to the official mark instead of
  leaving a blank cell.
- Only the "Uploaded image" source can be changed or removed here — the account picture
  belongs to the account and the official mark to the build.
- Choosing "Uploaded image" with nothing stored opens the file dialog right away.

dsh-brand-studio README · Screenshots：The sidebar brand row (account avatar + custom name + official Harness badge):

The five rows live in **Settings → General**:

dsh-brand-studio README · Requirements：- DSH **0.2.1-rc.3** or nearby (the version this was built and verified against).
- Web and desktop (Windows / macOS). The Windows caption layout's 1px shift is handled.

dsh-brand-studio README · Install：Install it straight from the Plugins page — no command line needed:

1. Open **Plugins** in the sidebar and click **Add plugin**.
2. Paste the repository address:

```
   https://github.com/elliotmasheal/dsh-brand-studio
   ```

3. Enable `dsh-brand-studio` if it did not enable itself, then refresh the page.
4. Open **Settings → General** and scroll down: five brand rows mean it worked.

dsh-brand-studio README · Install：If the repository is still private, the installing machine needs access to it; once it is
public the address is enough.

To remove it, uninstall the bundle from the plugin list; the brand seats return to the
official occupants immediately.

dsh-brand-studio README · Usage：The five rows (orders 40–44, after "Performance & usage"):

| Row | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Logo source | Three-way choice; the account item is disabled while signed out |
| Logo shape | Circle or rounded square |
| Logo image | 32px preview + choose / remove; disabled unless the source is "Uploaded image" |
| Brand name | Type to apply live; "Use official" clears it |
| Harness badge | Locked on while the official name is in use |

dsh-brand-studio README · Usage：Settings live in the renderer's `localStorage` (`dsh.custom-brand.v1`). Uploaded pictures
are centre-cropped to 192×192 WebP first, so they do not exhaust the quota. Everything is
per-device, with no sync.

dsh-brand-studio README · How it works：- Slots only, no DOM surgery: `sidebar.brand.mark` / `sidebar.brand.name` are occupied
  only while there is something to show (priority `-1` over the official occupant), and
  released otherwise so the shipped fish mark and wordmark return untouched.
- The settings are five `settings.general.item` rows rather than a page of their own.
- The avatar comes from the sanctioned Remote namespace: `ctx.remote.account.watch()`
  for the sign-in state and `getProfile({ version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds })` for
  `avatarUrl`, shown only after the browser decoded it.
- The Harness badge is not typed text: it is an inline SVG rebuilt from the official
  wordmark's own geometry, coloured with theme tokens.

dsh-brand-studio README · Development：```sh
node --check client.js
node --check index.js
```

Edits to `client.js` hot-reload; no restart needed. Conventions are in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

dsh-brand-studio README · Known limitations：- The badge geometry was extracted from the current DSH wordmark; a rebrand upstream means
  updating `HARNESS_GLYPHS`.
- Settings are local to this machine's `localStorage`.
- Mutually exclusive with any other plugin occupying `sidebar.brand.*`.
- The rows cannot live on the Account page: the settings system has no in-page seat and a
  reused section id replaces the whole page.
